project.json reference (MTDI 5.0)

Validated by mtdi/project.py; python -m mtdi check <project> reports the exact field that is wrong.

project (required)

FieldMeaning
idrequired; lowercase id, also the folder name
name, author, domain, taglineshown in the interface
descriptionone paragraph; [[term]] highlights a technical term

hardware

List of {"name", "role"}. Shown in the intro card and the spec strip.

sources (at least one)

adapterFields
serialport ("auto", /dev/ttyACM0, COM3, socket://host:port), baud (115200), vid (optional USB vendor id for auto)
tcplisten ("0.0.0.0:8765") or connect ("host:port")
httpdata_source ("HARDWARE" or "SOFTWARE"); posts go to /mtdi/ingest
pythoncallable ("package.module:function", a generator yielding lines or dicts), options, data_source
replayfile (JSONL from --record), loop (true), speed (1.0), from_source (filter)
processcommand (list), env (object), restart_after (2 s), data_source (SOFTWARE): any program whose stdout lines are protocol lines
systeminterval (1 s), disk (/): the host's CPU_PCT, MEM_PCT, SWAP_PCT, LOAD1, DISK_PCT, PROCS, NET_RX_KBS, NET_TX_KBS, TEMP_C
simulatorrate (lines/s), seed; always labelled SIMULATED

Every source needs a unique id. note is free text.

channels (at least one)

FieldDefaultMeaning
idrequiredunique channel id; NVTRA rules refer to it
labeliddisplay name
keysrequiredprotocol keys forming this channel, in axis order
kindvector if >1 keyscalar or vector
axeslowercase keysaxis names for a vector
sourcefirst sourcea source id, or a list of interchangeable source ids
domaingenericany lowercase word: magnetic, electric, ultrasonic, rf, thermal, inertial, compute, network, security, software, energy, … (physical is accepted as an alias)
unit""physical unit after scaling
scale, offset1, 0physical = raw × scale + offset; a number or one per key
raw_rangenone[low, high] raw limits; a raw value at either end is flagged as clipped
transformnoneac_rms: report the RMS about the mean over window samples (activity, vibration)
window25samples for ac_rms
noise_floor0.01smallest meaningful change, in unit (> 0)
noise_budget10 × floornoise a healthy channel should sit under at rest (resolution credit)
expected_ratenonesamples per second the source should deliver
stale_afterfrom rate, else 4 sseconds without a sample before the channel is stale
alert_change20 × floorsmallest change a person would call an event
optionalfalseif true and offline, it is left out of the score instead of scoring 0
simulatequiet{"mean": n or [..], "noise": n, "wave": {"amp", "hz"}, "events": true} in unit

environment

FieldDefaultMeaning
window10seconds of quiet samples a baseline learns from
auto_relock_afternullseconds a proven-stale, unlocked baseline waits before re-learning itself

weights

Override any of availability (0.20), baseline (0.15), signal_to_noise (0.20), clipping (0.15), timing (0.10), transient (0.10), axial_consensus (0.05), correlation (0.05). Weights are renormalised to sum to 1.

nvtra.rules

Ordered list; the first match wins after the universal offline/settling checks.

{"id": "…", "when": {"<channel id>": ">=6", "<channel id>": "<3", "active_at_least": 2},
 "condition": "short label", "text": "what it suggests, and what else could explain it"}

Comparisons (>=, >, <=, <, ==) are on the channel's signal-to-noise ratio. A named channel must be live for the rule to match.

aether

purpose, story (list), authorship (list), quote. Non-functional.

interface

FieldMeaning
intro{"title_top", "title_bottom"} for the startup intro
home_openingan I³ opening for Home, e.g. {"kind": "field", "title", "tagline"}
globe{"nodes": [{name, lon, lat, summary}], "links": [[a, b]]} for the Home globe
force_home_on_loadstart every full page load at Home
